title: Limola language
description: Austronesian language spoken in Sulawesi, Indonesia
extract: Limola is an Austronesian language of Sulawesi, Indonesia. It is spoken in two villages in North Luwu Regency, South Sulawesi. It is classified as a member of the Badaic subgroup of the South Sulawesi languages.
